combo_label: Pets & Petcare × Chocolate & Sweets × The Great Fire of London

entries.clue: Rendered fat for candles, stored by the barrel in the riverside warehouses
Great oak timber framing an old house, seasoned by a dry summer into fuel
French-sounding name for a little sweet, literally meaning 'good good'
Lifting engine with a long jib, busy on the quays and the building plots
The City's great market street, its goldsmiths' shops all consumed
Tom Baker's Doctor offered them from a paper bag: soft chewy infant shapes
Tunnel into soft earth and hollow out a den to hide in
Muddy four-toed mark tracked across a freshly mopped floor
Boiled sweets and tangy curd both take their sharpness from this yellow citrus
Roasted cocoa-bean fragment scattered over desserts; also a fountain pen's point
Curly German water dog, clipped into pompoms for the show ring
Highest rank of the peerage: James held it, and led the fight to halt the flames
Sudden short squeal from a dog whose foot has been trodden on
Raging mass of flame; four days of it swallowed most of the walled City
